variants.name: Ember Eraser
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original kuizer macOS/Linux desktop app icon, one standalone square 1024x1024 image. Create a NEW design using the attached Papertrail and Ghost images ONLY as references for tactile depth, edge lighting and softly sculpted surfaces; do not reproduce their symbols. Subject: a single substantial oblique artist's ERASER, with a warm ivory rubber tip and a burnt-orange translucent amber glass sleeve. The eraser body is a compact beveled rectangular prism, NOT a capsule, pill, pencil or brush. Beautiful asymmetrical diagonal silhouette rising bottom-left to upper-right, one crisp diagonal seam, soft ivory bevel on the working edge, two tiny square eraser crumbs near the tip. It represents carefully clearing regenerable developer files. Behind the eraser is a charcoal rounded-square app tile, subtle concentric machining, restrained warm rim light, a shallow natural cast shadow. Palette: charcoal #171717, warm ivory #fff0da, terracotta #d97757, amber #f0a56b. Framing: icon fills 85% of square, front three-quarter view with strong identifiable silhouette at small size. Refined studio lighting, physically plausible satin ceramic and polished glass, restrained highlights rather than neon overload. Actual transparent background OUTSIDE the charcoal rounded square. No words, letters, text, captions, watermark, decorative stars, multiple options or mockup sheet. This is a logo asset, not a screen UI.

variants.name: Fold
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original kuizer macOS/Linux desktop application icon, standalone 1024x1024 square. Create a NEW emblem, called Fold, for a precise keyboard-driven disk cleaner. Attached Papertrail and Linear images are references ONLY for sculpted geometry, translucent material, restrained illumination, not shapes to reproduce. Subject: a clearly readable capital K made from ONE continuous broad folded ribbon of warm amber and copper glass. The K must read from its outline: strong vertical left stem, distinct upper-right diagonal arm and lower-right diagonal leg, generous triangular dark negative spaces; no P, R, arrow, loop or lightning bolt. Ribbon folds expose an ivory satin inner surface and subtly translucent orange outer face, sculptural depth, beautiful fine specular edging, slight front three-quarter perspective but strongly legible. A graphite rounded-square app tile frames the isolated centered K, with a quiet dark surface and warm light catching just one edge. Shape occupies 75% of tile, tile occupies 90% of canvas. Palette charcoal #171717, orange #d97757, copper #bf603d, pale amber #ffd9a6. A premium practical desktop tool, controlled lighting, crisp silhouette with rich but restrained materials. Transparent canvas OUTSIDE the app tile. One single finished icon, no words other than the K SYMBOL, no wordmark, captions, watermark, numbers, grid or alternative views. This is a logo asset, not screen UI.

variants.name: Clearspace
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: new original kuizer macOS/Linux desktop app icon, square 1024x1024. The application discovers disk usage and lets the user choose what to clear. Create a new icon concept called Clearspace. Attached Linear and Ghost pictures are references ONLY for physical sculpted depth, softly frosted surfaces and refined edge lighting, not their existing symbols. Subject: a bold square mosaic of FOUR chunky rounded rectangular tiles, arranged as a compact asymmetrical disk-usage TREEMAP, slight isometric view. One large frosted ivory rectangular tile on the left, two smaller smoked-jade tiles stacked on right, and one small luminous copper-orange tile being neatly LIFTED out from a corner, exposing a clean dark empty recess. Exact arrangement should be simple and visually balanced with clearly visible gaps; the removed tile floats just a little above its own gap, symbolizing deliberately reclaiming disk space. Object feels like satin ceramic inlaid into translucent jade glass, refined industrial design and broad confident faces. Matte charcoal rounded-square app base, subtle studio shadow, no clutter, no particles, no fine seams, no text. Main icon fills 80% of square. Palette deep jade #335f4f, ivory #f4eee1, smoky charcoal #171717, a single terracotta #d97757 highlight on the removed tile. The geometry must remain recognizable at 32 pixels. Actual transparent background outside the rounded-square base. One finished icon, no letters, words, numerals, watermark, captions, screens, charts with labels, grid of options or mockup sheet. This is the icon itself.
